fusions.name: Throat-Sac Howl
fusions.desc: Howls in a cone out to 5 tiles, dealing 12 damage to everything caught in it and stunning it for 1 second, with a 50% chance to leave each target [Slowed] for 3 seconds.

fusions.name: Slick Palm
fusions.desc: A bare-fisted strike that deals 7 damage and makes the target [Poisoned] for 2 damage a second for 5 seconds. Holds 3 charges; each use spends one, and each kill restores one.

fusions.name: Puff-Chest Spring
fusions.desc: Raises your armour by 25% for 11 seconds. You finish it 2 tiles from where you stood.

fusions.name: Snap Reflex
fusions.desc: Each time anything but fire hurts you, your physical damage rises 25% for 4 seconds. Once every 8 seconds. You have 6% more dodge chance.
